narration.title: 188 countries
narration.text: Coloured by continent, on a globe.

narration.title: Planets
narration.text: Each country lifts off as a planet, as large as its population, orbiting in its continent's ring.

narration.title: A golden spiral
narration.text: Smallest at the centre, the giants on the rim — each country turned by the golden angle from the last.

narration.title: Area is people
narration.text: Asia alone is more than half of everyone.
